Job Description: Overview:
**Create value at TC Transcontinental.** **At TC Transcontinental, we've got it made, and that's because of the expertise of our team.** **We have been driving innovation since 1976\.**  

Founded 50 years ago and 4,000 employees strong, Transcontinental Inc. (TSX: TCL.A TCL.B), known under the TC Transcontinental brand, is a Canadian retail marketing services company, Canada's largest printer, and the Canadian leader in French\-language educational publishing. Driven by the vision of a more informed, educated and prosperous society, TC Transcontinental propels its clients' success across the retail, education, book and information industries. With agility, creativity and boldness, we design and deliver innovative, high\-value products and services.  

We are looking for a Graphic Production Artist on a 12\-month contract to utilize their talent to generate, format and assemble electronic layouts for print and digital media.  

This position is currently open and reflects a replacement position due to an internal transfer.  

The salary range for this position is $50,000 to $56,000 per year, commensurate with experience, education, and internal equity. This range is provided to ensure clarity and promote equitable access to employment opportunities.
Responsibilities:
**When your actions lead to success:**  

Our Graphic Production Artists and Designers are the creators behind the many flyers seen by consumers across the country. A GPA will utilize their talent to generate, format and assemble electronic layouts for print and digital media in both English and French. With a strong foundation in computer graphics and working knowledge of programs such as Adobe InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop and After Effects, a GPA will have the opportunity to produce flyers and POPs that help retailers reach their target consumers.  

  

This position is responsible for overseeing electronic layout of print media that includes determining the elements required for the page layout. The incumbent will determine the text, artwork, colors, file types and formats to produce the flyer and/or POP that are aligned with the customer’s requirements and Company standards.  

  

**What you will do:*** 80% production and 20% design
* Utilize Adobe Creative Suite Applications
* Input required graphic elements such as artwork, copy, etc.;
* Produce templates for page layouts in collaboration with the design team;
* Ensure projects are created to specification and produce proofs for approval;
* Format all files to print and digital standards;
* Support and contribute to a healthy and safe work environment by following all workplace regulations, policies, and initiatives, including reporting all first aid injuries, accidents, and workplace hazards.

  


Qualifications:
**When your expertise drives us:*** Degree (or work experience equivalent) in computer graphics, design and print production;
* 3\-5 years experience as a Graphic Layout/Production Artist and Designers;
* Strong knowledge of InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop
* Solid understanding of the Mac Operating System (OSX);
* Strong analytical, interpersonal and communication skills;
* Retail Flyer Graphic Production experience an asset;
* Strong problem\-solving skills, ability to perform under pressure and demonstrated leadership skills, working well within a team environment;
* Detail\-oriented.
* French is an asset.

 **When benefits really help you live better:**  

We offer a comprehensive and flexible benefits package designed to support your well\-being and help you thrive—at work and at home. Our offerings include:* Competitive compensation with performance\-based incentives and retirement savings plans with company match
* Customizable group benefits including health, dental, life, disability, and travel insurance
* Paid time off
* Employee perks such as discounts on insurance, wireless plans, travel, and more
* Career development opportunities
* A dynamic, inclusive work environment where your voice matters and your growth is supported

**EEO**  

TC Transcontinental is committed to fair, transparent, and equitable hiring practices. We disclose that no artificial intelligence (AI) tools or automated decision\-making systems are used in our recruitment or selection process.  

TC Transcontinental is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and accessible workplace. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws in the jurisdictions where we operate.  

We are also committed to providing an inclusive and barrier\-free recruitment and work environment—promoting dignity, independence, integration, and equal opportunity for all, including persons with disabilities. Accommodations, including alternative formats, will be made available for all parts of the recruitment and selection process. For more information or to request an accommodation please contact talent@tc.tc.  

Send us your application. Create something with TC Transcontinental.

Job Description: **About The Media Firm.**

The Media Firm. is a Toronto\-based content marketing agency specializing in high\-performing content for premium brands across the Greater Toronto Area: real estate professionals, builders, and design\-focused brands.

In addition to client work, we operate a growing real estate media platform with strong audience reach (100k\+ followers) across Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube. This platform runs its own content pipeline (submissions, property content, brand partnerships) on the same operational standard we bring to every client account.

**Role Overview**

We are building a luxury lifestyle event brand and we need someone to build the visual and brand foundation it launches on. The venues are secured. The guest list is built. The first event is ready to execute. What does not exist yet is the brand. No logo. No color system. No visual identity. No website. Nothing.

The person we hire will build all of it from a blank canvas.

Picture an invitation\-only experience where the guest list is as curated as the environment itself. The room will be filled with real estate professionals, automotive enthusiasts, tech founders, investors, and entrepreneurs. It is exclusive by design, and the brand needs to communicate that sense of belonging before anyone has even been invited.

Three brands capture the direction we are building toward. Malbon built a visual identity so strong that people wore the brand before they ever played the game. Malbon Home extended that into intimate, community\-driven storytelling that made the brand feel personal, not just aesthetic. Hampton Founders built a network so carefully curated that people wanted in before they even knew what was inside. We are building all three of those qualities into one brand: the visual world of Malbon, the storytelling of Malbon Home, and the access positioning of Hampton Founders.

If you follow all three and immediately understand why they work, you already understand what we are trying to build.

This is also an AI\-first role. You will use Claude to accelerate research, brand naming, guidelines copy, and campaign ideation. Your job is to bring the creative vision, direct that output, and execute at a standard that makes the brand look like it has been around for years on launch day.

**Core Responsibilities**

Brand Identity and Visual System (AI\-Assisted)

* Build the full brand identity from scratch: logo, wordmark, color palette, typography, and visual language
* Use Claude to research brand positioning, naming directions, and competitive landscape. Apply your creative judgment to what comes out
* Write and design the full brand guidelines document: a real brand bible that anyone on the team can execute from
* Own brand consistency across every touchpoint from launch day forward

Digital Presence: Website and Email (AI\-Assisted)

* Design and build the brand website. Brand\-forward, not template\-forward
* Use Claude to draft website copy, then refine and apply your voice to it
* Design email newsletter templates and campaign assets

Event Branding and Campaign Assets (AI\-Assisted)

* Design the full event branding kit: signage, digital announcements, on\-site materials, and sponsor\-facing assets
* Design ongoing graphic assets for social, launch announcements, and event promotions
* Maintain brand consistency across every event touchpoint

Content Marketing Strategy (AI\-Assisted)

* Take lead on the content marketing strategy: how the brand tells its story before, during, and after each event
* Use Claude to research content formats, build content calendars, and map the narrative arc of each event cycle
* Bring your perspective on what this brand should look and feel like in motion, not just in print
* Collaborate directly with the founder on strategic direction while owning the execution of the content plan
* Provide creative direction on shoots, video content, and social storytelling across the event series

**What We're Looking For**

* A portfolio that proves you have built a brand from the ground up, not just executed inside someone else's system
* Strong aesthetic sense for lifestyle, luxury, and premium event positioning
* Proficiency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator and Photoshop at minimum)
* Experience designing and building websites (Webflow, Squarespace, or similar)
* Email design experience (Klaviyo, Mailchimp, or similar)
* Fully fluent in Claude and other AI tools as the core way of working. This is not a bonus skill, it is the foundation of how we operate
* Organized, proactive, and able to manage your own timeline without hand\-holding

**Bonus Experience**

* Experience branding luxury, automotive, or real estate products
* Background in experiential marketing or event branding
* Understanding of how community\-driven lifestyle brands are built, not just designed

**Compensation**

This is a ground\-floor engagement. Upfront compensation is limited, and we are transparent about that. What we are offering is real creative ownership, access to a high\-caliber network, and a path to ongoing involvement as the brand grows.

If that is not the right fit for where you are, no hard feelings. If it is, let us talk.

**Why Join The Media Firm.**

* Build a brand from nothing that goes on to host rooms full of successful entrepreneurs, tech founders, investors, and automotive enthusiasts at some of the most exclusive events in Canada
* Creative ownership from day one, no committee, no revisions by committee
* Work inside an AI\-first operation built for speed and output
* A path to continued involvement and growing scope for the right person

* Some travel required for store visits \& training and to home office – 10\-20%.


 This role reports to the VP Marketing and will manage one direct report.

Job Description: **About THINKINK** 
  
 



 THINKINK is a specialist B2B communications agency working with technology companies in the aviation, loyalty, payments, retail, sustainability and travel sectors. We help B2B companies build and improve visibility, strengthen market positioning and support commercial growth through integrated communications, media relations, research and content programs. Clients come to us to solve business problems through smart strategy, compelling storytelling and thoughtful design.  
 



  
 



**Design at THINKINK** 
  
 



 Design is central to how we help clients communicate complex ideas. Whether we're launching a travel payments company, producing research that influences an industry or creating executive thought leadership, design helps turn strategy into something people understand, remember and act on. You'll have a seat at the table from the beginning of projects, not simply when it's time to "make it look good." We expect this role to contribute ideas, challenge assumptions and help shape the work alongside other team members. 
 



  
 



**The Role** 
  
 



 We're looking for a Lead Creative Designer who combines strategic thinking with exceptional creative execution. In this role, you will lead creative from concept to delivery across multiple B2B client accounts. This is a hands\-on, senior position: you are the creative strategy in the room with the client and the person executing behind the scenes. You won't be handing direction down to a senior designer to interpret, and you won't be waiting for someone to translate your work for web, social or digital; you think and build natively in those channels. 
 



  
 



 You'll work directly with clients, writers, strategists, developers and PR professionals, leading creative discussions, presenting your ideas and producing outstanding design work across websites, social media, reports, presentations, campaigns and brand identities. You're equally comfortable discussing website user journeys with a developer, presenting creative concepts to a client, refining information hierarchy with a content strategist or opening Figma to design the solution and get the work shipped on deadline. 
 



  
 



**Responsibilities** 
  
 



  
 



**Creative Strategy \& Direction** 
  
 


* Develop and own visual brand and creative strategy for THINKINK clients and the THINKINK brand
* Translate client business, communications and campaign goals into clear creative concepts and direction
* Set the creative vision for accounts and carry visual consistency through every stage of design and production
* Present, explain and defend creative strategy and concepts directly to clients



  
 



**Hands\-On Design Execution** 
  
 


* Personally execute high\-quality design across digital campaigns, social, web, email, presentations and brand systems
* Produce high\-quality reports, eBooks, white papers and similar B2B marketing assets
* Design event graphics, exhibition materials and other event\-specific assets
* Build provocative, creative concepts for B2B social media and digital marketing, without being boring
* Create and evolve visual brand guides for clients (logo, typography, color, brand style)
* Support client website redesigns with design that's built for the web, not adapted to it
* Produce advanced, on\-brand presentations that pair messaging with strong visual design
* Edit and retouch images, documents and assets for digital and, where needed, print



  
 



**Digital\-First Delivery** 
  
 


* Design natively for web, social, email and digital campaigns, working within responsive and digital constraints
* Collaborate directly with developers and digital teams without needing work to be translated between disciplines
* Use AI\-assisted tools to speed up concepting, iteration and production across channels, setting the standard for how the team adopts them
* Stay current on digital design, motion and typography trends and bring them to client work



  
 



**Client \& Account Partnership** 
  
 


* Act as the senior creative lead in client relationships and meetings
* Partner with account managers and leadership to scope creative work and manage client expectations
* Balance feedback from clients and internal teams to deliver brilliant creative and strong results



  
 



**Team Collaboration** 
  
 


* Work across PR, content, digital, social and research functions to align creative with broader client programs
* Pick up projects mid\-stream as needed and carry brand consistency through to delivery
* Help raise the creative bar and creative processes across the agency as it grows



  
 



**What We're Looking For** 
  
 



 You understand that great design starts with asking the right questions, not opening design software. 
 



 You naturally think about audience, messaging, user experience and business objectives before considering colors, typography or layout. You're curious, collaborative and commercially aware. You know when to challenge a brief, when to defend a creative recommendation and when to adapt your approach based on client feedback. 
 



  
 



 You enjoy working in a fast\-paced agency environment where every day is different, priorities often shift depending on clients’ changing needs, and you'll move between multiple brands and industries in the same week or even day. 
 



  
 



**What You’ll Bring** 
  
 


* 8\+ years in design, with clear progression to a lead, Associate Creative Director or Creative Director level, including agency client\-service experience (PR, advertising or marketing)
* Proven track record in owning creative strategy and presenting it directly to clients
* A digital\-first portfolio: B2B work designed natively for web, social, email and digital campaigns
* Experience leading creative workstreams independently — directing and executing, not working under a senior designer
* Expert across Adobe Creative Cloud (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign)
* Strong working command of Figma
* Fluency with generative AI design tools (image, video and copy) and the ability to build AI\-assisted creative workflows that accelerate concepting and production without sacrificing craft
* Advanced presentation design skills in Microsoft PowerPoint and Google Slides
* Excellent communication and people skills, and confidence as the senior creative in front of clients
* Strong attention to detail, accuracy and follow\-through under tight timelines
* Comfortable working remotely and in a small, distributed team



  
 



**Ideal Experience** 
  
 


* B2B technology experience, especially in aviation, travel, fintech/payments, loyalty, retail or sustainability
* Motion design, animation or video editing
* Brand identity and design\-system development
* Print and production experience
* Working knowledge of HTML/CSS
* Degree in Graphic Design or a related field



  
 



**Why THINKINK?** 
  
 



 You'll have the opportunity to shape the creative direction for THINKINK and for our global B2B clients while working alongside an experienced team of strategists, writers, PR professionals and researchers. We believe our best work comes from collaboration, curiosity and giving talented people the freedom to do what they do best. We're remote\-first with colleagues and clients across North America, Europe and Australia. 
 



  
 



**Benefits** 
  
 


* Fully remote work environment
* Flexible vacation and personal time policy
* Comprehensive medical, dental and vision insurance
* Membership to WeWork co\-working spaces
* Professional development and continuing education support.
* Opportunity to work with B2B brands in aviation, travel, loyalty, sustainability, fintech and retail

Job Description: The Royal Conservatory (RCM) is one of the largest and most respected music education institutions in the world, providing the definitive standard of excellence in curriculum design, assessment, performance training, and teacher certification. Graduates from its two performance training programs, The Glenn Gould School and The Phil \& Eli Taylor Performance Academy for Young Artists, regularly perform on major international stages. The RCM is also a leader in the development of early childhood education programs and arts\-based social programs, and presents a diverse range of concerts featuring the finest Canadian and international artists in its magnificent performance space, Koerner Hall. Please visit
 
 www.rcmusic.com
 
 for more information.
 



  





**What is the Opportunity?** 




 The Event Coordinator is part of the RCM’s Performing Arts Division and will have responsibility for coordinating meetings and events at The Royal Conservatory. Events will include performances, recitals, rehearsals, concerts, galas, receptions, dinners, social events such as weddings and parties, AGMs, launch events, and meetings. Clients will include performing arts organizations; corporate, social, not\-for\-profit, and media organizations; individuals; and RCM internal groups.
 



  





 Event spaces range in size from our showcase 1,135 seat concert hall to our smaller concert halls and event spaces. All events produced at the RCM are managed by our professional, innovative and customer\-oriented event team, with sensitivity to the RCM’s academic programs and organizational goals. **Main Duties \& Responsibilities** 



* Promote and sell RCM event spaces to event clients.
* Coordinate site visits for potential clients.
* Compile all event information in a timely fashion to complete an accurate and clear event proposal for each potential client.
* Manage all communication between event client and the RCM in a timely and professional manner.
* Ensure that client is aware of and adheres to all RCM event policies.
* Participate in and coordinate all aspects of event planning for each event to ensure compliance with supplier contracts and RCM policies.
* Act as the onsite contact for events, including coordinating deliveries, suppliers, event set up, facility preparedness, signage, client assistance and all planning and day of event requirements.
* Assist and work with the RCM Facilities staff, catering staff, all delivery and décor staff and all departments where applicable, to ensure that the guest's needs and requirements are fulfilled, while protecting the integrity of the RCM academic and performance activities.
* Ensure that all RCM suppliers and RCM departments are aware of their specific duties pertaining to the group while they are guests of the RCM.
* The coordinator acts as the on\-site contact for their assigned groups, and will assist other coordinators with full on\-site coverage of all groups on\-site as necessary.
* Assisting with the event billing, event reports and issuing thank\-you letters following each event.
* Recording and maintaining accurate records for each event and for each potential sales contact.
* Attend weekly Facility Rentals function/event meeting to discuss upcoming events.
* Perform other duties as required.



  





**What We're Looking For** 



* Minimum of 3 years of experience as an Event Coordinator with performance, corporate and social events.
* Experience working at a performing arts venue would be an asset.
* Positive and professional attitude.
* Exemplary customer service skills and demonstrated ability to work well with people of diverse backgrounds.
* Familiarity with local event suppliers and local annual events.
* Willingness and ability to work effectively under pressure and respond nimbly to deadlines, able to perform well in stressful situations.
* Careful, diplomatic and highly organized.
* Assiduous attention to detail.
* Excellent verbal and written skills.
* Good negotiating skills.
* Team oriented with an ability to work independently.
* Problem\-solving skills, diplomacy.
* Must be able to handle many details with care and be multi\-task oriented.



  





**Salary Range** 



* $50,000 \- $53,000 per annum.

Job Description: Marks, part of the Propelis Group, Marks is a consumer experience agency creating engaging moments across the entire brand spectrum—from brand design and packaging, to content and consumer connections. We are a collaborative global network of 1,900\+ team members across 25\+ studios and 20\+ countries, partnering with some of the world’s most recognized brands to solve complex business challenges through design, strategy, and craft.
 



  





 We are looking for a designer at the intersection of brand and digital commerce. If you’ve got a love for design in all its forms, from brand to packaging to digital—you might be a great fit. We’re looking for a well rounded designer with an eye for detail, who can craft creative solutions for e\-commerce and beyond.
 



  





**What you will be doing** 



* Deliver best in class content (brand and product visuals and communication), on eComm product pages or online storefronts (DTC or retailers such as Amazon, Walmart, Target, etc.)
* You have great design chops – working independently or collaboratively within a team
* Support the development of design solutions, with a focus on digital content channels and eComm
* Actively participate in brainstorming sessions and internal reviews
* Play an active role in supporting both your immediate colleagues and those across the agency
* Uphold creative integrity and ingenuity by keeping up to date with the latest best practices in eComm, including ADA compliance
* Take personal responsibility and guardianship for your projects – ensuring accurate, consistent, and timely completion of high quality work
* Present your work with the confidence that comes from knowing that you have done all that you can
* Be an active participant in agency life and get involved with internal initiatives



  





**Key qualities** 



* Highly collaborative and accountable
* A strategic problem solver with experience in Consumer Packaged Goods
* Ideally experience in food/drink categories
* Has an excitement for their discipline that is contagious
* Thrive in the demands of pressing deadlines and managing multiple priorities
* Solid communicator who can convey rationale behind design solutions
* Understands consumer purchase behavior and can think in design systems and overarching brand position
* ‘Roll\-up\-your\-sleeves and do’ mindset



  





**Reporting to:** 




 Design Director, Digital Commerce
 



  





**Extended team partners:** 



* Agency leadership
* Marks global strategy team
* Creative Director \+ creative partners
* Account leads



  





**Experience** 



* 4\+ years experience in the industry; some agency experience
* Bachelor’s degree in design or other related field
* Experience with a range of categories including CPG, food/ beverage/wine/spirits, and technology preferred
* Knowledge of simple animation/motion techniques a plus
* Well\-rounded portfolio showcasing excellent understanding of brand building — experience in front\-end development for eComm a plus
* Good understanding of Mac OS, Adobe CS (Solid knowledge of Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign); collaborative tools (XD, Miro) and Keynote a plus

 Propelis is a portfolio of global marketing services and technology companies with a combined legacy of

 **9,000 employees**

 **30** 
 countries. Propelis provides the scale and support of a global organization while preserving the unique culture and identity of each company in its portfolio. For more information visit: www.MakeMarks.com

Job Description: **About The Position** 




 SearchKings is hiring a
 **Creative Digital Designer** 
 to elevate our Web \& Creative Services team.
 



  





 In this new role, you will define the visual strategy that drives conversion. You will leverage a modern, tech\-forward workflow to deliver high\-fidelity designs for internal initiatives and client marketing campaigns. You will work cross\-functionally with Developers, Project Managers, and stakeholders to bridge the gap between aesthetic excellence and performance metrics.
 



  





 We are seeking a designer who embodies the future of the industry, someone who seamlessly integrates traditional design principles with advanced Figma expertise and the efficiency of AI\-augmented workflows.
 



  





**What You Will Do** 



* **Visual Branding:** 
 Develop, maintain, and evolve comprehensive
 **Brand Guidelines** 
 for SearchKings and key clients, ensuring consistency across all touchpoints (web, video, and print).
* **Campaign Creative:** 
 conceptualize and execute visually stunning advertising creative (static and motion) that breaks through the noise of modern feeds.
* **Future\-Proof Workflows:** 
 Champion the use of
 **Figma, Adobe Products and Ai** 
 integration. You will utilize AI to align design tokens with development, ensuring that your creative vision is perfectly translated into code without manual friction.
* **Strategic Communication:** 
 Act as a strategic bridge between stakeholders and production, translating complex visions into polished, high\-performance designs.



  





**Key Qualifications** 




**Creative \& Brand Mastery** 



* **Brand Systems Architecture:** 
 You have a portfolio demonstrating the creation and maintenance of robust brand guidelines. You know how to build a visual language that scales across different media (digital, print, event, merch).
* **Visual Storytelling:** 
 You don't just design "assets"; you tell stories. You have a strong background in art direction, typography, and colour theory, with the ability to evoke emotion through design.
* **Trend Fluency:** 
 You stay ahead of the curve in the design world. You are familiar with current aesthetic shifts and can articulate
 *why* 
 a design looks "dated" vs. "modern."



**Technical Innovation** 



* **Figma \+ Ai** 
 You are comfortable working in a modern, AI\-assisted pipeline. You understand how to use
 **Ai** 
 in tandem with
 **Figma** 
 to bridge the gap between creative intent and frontend implementation (e.g., managing design tokens, checking feasibility, or prototyping complex interactions). Cursor, Microsoft Clarity and more tools should guide your design decisions.
* **Advanced Adobe Creative Cloud:** 
 High\-level proficiency in Illustrator (branding/vectors), Photoshop (high\-end compositing), and After Effects (motion graphics).



**Professional Leadership** 



* **Communication:** 
 You can explain a creative concept to a client or stakeholder with passion and clarity.
* **Project Management:** 
 Ability to manage multiple creative lanes simultaneously, switching from a branding project to a web project.
* **Attention to Detail:** 
 You are the person who notices when a logo is 2px off\-center. You value polish and craftsmanship above all else.



  





**In addition to the above technical skills, a member of our team must possess the following skills:** 



* Strong multitasking skills to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
* Delivery of high\-quality, well\-tested work in a timely manner.
* An understanding of what makes a design attractive from a customer’s perspective.
* Attention to detail and a passion for delivering high\-quality design solutions.
* Enjoy working in a fast\-paced, growing company that has a lot of fun!



  





**Equal Opportunity Employer:** 




 SearchKings is committed to the principle of equal employment opportunity for all employees and to providing a work environment free from discrimination and harassment.
 



  





 SearchKings is committed to meeting the accessibility needs of persons with disabilities in an effective and timely manner by preventing and removing barriers for persons with disabilities in accordance with applicable legislation, including the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act, 2005 and the Ontario Human Rights Code (the “Code”).
 



  





 The Company has policies and procedures in respect of the provision of accommodations in all parts of the recruitment, assessment and onboarding process. If you feel you need accommodation(s) because of illness, disability or any other protected ground, please do not hesitate to contact us at your earliest convenience.

Job Description: Company Description
 



 TBL Digital is a bold, innovative marketing agency specializing in content creation, social media management, paid ads, and influencer partnerships. Focused on helping food, beverage, hospitality, travel, and e\-commerce brands stand out, TBL Digital creates impactful, high\-performance content to drive conversions and build loyal audiences. With a no\-nonsense approach to marketing, the team is committed to crafting disruptive and authentic storytelling. Based in Toronto and serving both local and global clients, TBL Digital brings expertise in restaurant and hospitality marketing, paid campaigns, and social media growth to deliver exceptional results.
 



  





 Role Description
 



 This is a full\-time, on\-location role for a Food Photographer \& Videographer. You'll plan and execute visually striking photo and video shoots for restaurant, food, and beverage clients — then own the post\-production workflow on non\-shoot days, editing short\-form video (Reels, TikToks) and designing static social media posts. You'll collaborate directly with the creative team to deliver content aligned with client brand identities across social media campaigns, ads, and promotional materials.
 



 This role requires reliable personal transportation, as you'll travel across the GTA (and occasionally beyond) for client shoots.
 



  





 Responsibilities
 


* Plan, style, light, and shoot high\-quality food and beverage photography and videography on location
* Edit and deliver short\-form video content (Reels, TikToks, Stories) on non\-shoot days
* Create polished static posts and carousel graphics for social media
* Develop creative concepts, shot lists, and mood boards in collaboration with the team
* Manage your own shoot schedule and equipment, meeting deadlines in a fast\-paced environment
* Stay current on social media trends and platform\-specific content formats (Instagram, TikTok, Pinterest)



 Qualifications
 


* 2\+ years of proven experience in food and beverage photography and videography (portfolio required)
* Strong proficiency in photo and video editing — Lightroom, Photoshop, Premiere Pro, CapCut, or equivalent
* Demonstrated ability to create both short\-form video and static social content end\-to\-end
* Solid understanding of lighting techniques, composition, and on\-location shoot management
* Experience working with restaurants, hospitality, or lifestyle brands is a strong plus
* Reliable vehicle and valid driver's license (mandatory — travel to client locations is required)
* Bachelor's degree in Visual Arts, Film, Design, or related field is preferred but not required
* High creativity, sharp attention to detail, and the ability to work independently

Job Description: *Please note: This role is not internal to Nuovo. You will be directly employed by our trusted manufacturing partner, GTA Imaging, who produces our premium photo albums and frames.*
 GTA Imaging is a wholesale, professional photography lab and printing company with over 40 years of experience and serving photographers all across Canada. We are a family owned and operated business providing custom made albums and photographic wall art and fine art prints.
   

  

 As a
 **Client Success \& Marketing Specialist** 
 based in Toronto, you'll be the face of our brand. We're looking for an extroverted, autonomous, and hands\-on professional to build loyal relationships with our creative community (in person and online) while spearheading our marketing campaigns. If you love talking to people, have an eye for merchandising, and want to help us expand, this role is for you.
   

  

 This is an excellent opportunity for someone who thrives in a fast\-paced, multi\-faceted setting, combines retail or hospitality charm with marketing savvy, and takes pride in delivering a high\-touch, growth\-oriented partner experience.
   

  

**What You'll Do:**
 Client Success \& Photographer Relations:
   

  

* Be the Champion for Photographers: Serve as the primary contact via phone, email, in person, and social media with a positive, team\-player attitude
* Consultative Sales \& Business Development: Actively engage with clients, pitch our offerings, and drive business growth by helping photographers scale
* Become the Product Expert: Master our premium photo album and framing lines, and confidently articulate their technical details and value
* Consult \& Guide: Act as a trusted advisor, helping photographers select the perfect products, layouts, and finishes for their brand


 Marketing \& Digital Community:
   

  

* Drive Online Campaigns: Conceptualize, launch, and maintain email marketing campaigns and website updates (promotions, new product launches)
* Social Media \& Content Creation: Manage our social media presence, creating inspiring content and engaging with our creative online community
* Own the Software Backend: Maintain and update our backend ordering platform with fresh features and product options
* Curate the Showroom \& Merchandising: Design the physical showroom space, regularly updating samples with a strong eye for visual presentation

Job Description: We are seeking a highly organized, detail\-oriented, and professional **Academic Assistant / Secretary** to directly support a leading Pediatrician based in Scarborough. This unique hybrid role bridges clinical front\-desk support, high\-level research administration, and academic project management.

The ideal candidate has a strong background in science or health studies, thrives in an organized environment, and is looking for a stable, long\-term, part\-time position where they will receive comprehensive training. **Strict confidentiality and discretion are absolute requirements for this role.**

**Commitment:** Minimum 2\-year commitment required

**Key Responsibilities**

**Research \& Academic Support**

* **Data Management:** Execute precise patient data collection and manage Electronic Data Capture (EDC) systems in strict compliance with healthcare privacy standards.
* **Regulatory \& Compliance:** Handle official communication and documentation submissions to relevant institutional and healthcare regulatory authorities.
* **Project \& Deadline Tracking:** Manage strict timelines for research paper submissions, peer reviews, manuscript corrections, and journal edits.
* **Conference Preparation:** Should be able to design and format high\-quality PowerPoint presentations, coordinate logistics/materials for upcoming workshops and medical conferences.
* **Editorial Assistance:** Assist the physician with administrative tasks tied to medical book editing, chapter revisions, and literature reviews.

**Administrative \& Clinical Front Desk Duties**

* **Clinic Reception:** Provide welcoming, professional front\-desk coverage at the Scarborough hospital/clinic location as needed.
* **Meeting Coordination:** Attend research and administrative meetings, take detailed minutes, and follow up on actionable items.
* **General Administration:** Manage correspondence, phone inquiries, digital filing, and other miscellaneous administrative tasks to ensure day\-to\-day operations run seamlessly.

**Qualifications \& Requirements**

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Biology, Health Sciences, Health Studies, Biotechnology, Chemistry, or a closely related scientific field.
* **Experience:** Previous exposure to administrative environments (medical, clinic, or corporate office setting) is highly preferred.
* **Communication:** Exceptional verbal and written English communication skills, with the ability to draft professional emails, research communications, and interface with regulatory bodies.
* **Technical Skills:** Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (especially PowerPoint and Word); familiarity with Electronic Data Capture (EDC) or Electronic Medical Records (EMR) software is a strong asset.
* **Attributes:** High level of integrity, absolute respect for patient confidentiality, incredible attention to detail, and strong organizational skills.
* **Availability:** Must be able to commit to the role for a **minimum of 2 years** (Comprehensive training will be provided to the right candidate).

**How to Apply**

Interested candidates are invited to submit their Resume and a brief Cover Letter outlining their interest in health/academic research and their availability at **positionhire155@gmail.com**.

*We thank all applicants for their interest; however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted.*

Pay: $18\.75\-$20\.00 per hour

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Scarborough, ON

Job Description: **JOB SUMMARY:**


The SE Research Centre conducts impact\-oriented health services research to synthesize, generate, translate, adapt and directly apply scientific evidence in the design, delivery and evaluation of person and family\-centred health and social care services.  

The primary role of the Research Associate is to provide strong project management to scientific research studies conducted in the SE Research Centre, including management of research ethics board approvals. The Research Associate is also responsible for high quality quantitative and/or qualitative data collection, data management, and data analysis, including engagement of research participants using best practices in participatory research. In collaboration with Senior Research Associates and Research Scientists, Research Associates will also participate in academic and lay audience knowledge mobilization opportunities and support SE Research Centre team initiatives for ongoing improvement/maintenance of collaboration, efficiency and engagement

 **JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**Project Management of Scientific Research Studies**

* Lead development and management of research study project documentation used within the SE Research Centre program
	+ Project Summary
	+ Project Plan/ Timeline
	+ Master Project File/ Milestones/ Publication List
	+ Meeting Agendas and Action Items
	+ Project Budget Template
* Manage flow of communication across study teams, including coordination and leadership of project meetings
* Manage Research Ethics Board Submissions, Amendments, Renewals and Closures in collaboration with Senior Research Associates/ Research Scientists
* Support Senior Research Associates/ Research Scientists in the development of study budgets; track all expenses against approved study budget(s)
 **Qualitative and Quantitative Data Collection and Analysis**

* Lead recruitment and informed consent process for SE Research Centre studies
* Support development of data collection tools in collaboration with Senior Research Associates and/or Research Scientists
* Collect qualitative and quantitative data using best methodological practices and according to approved REB research protocol
* Implement REB approved management practices including for organization, storage, and destruction
* Implement data analysis activities with support from Senior Research Associates/ Research Scientists, including assistance with data interpretation

 **Knowledge Mobilization \& Team Support**

* Write conference abstracts, prepare and lead presentations in collaboration with Senior Research Associates
* Draft/ Update Research project summaries in collaboration with Senior Research Associates/ Research Scientists
* Participate in the preparation and writing of peer\-reviewed publications in collaboration with SE Research Centre colleagues
* Support SE Research Centre team initiatives to improve/ maintain collaboration, efficiency and engagement

 **QUALIFICATIONS:**

**Education and Experience**

* A minimum of five years of experience participating in relevant health services research activities
* Experience with writing for various audiences, including academic publication
* Experience mentoring others in an academic and/or research context
* Tri\-Council Policy Statement (2\): Ethical Conduct of Research Involving Humans certificate
* GBA\+ training

 **Skill/ Competency Requirements**

* Ability to employ a wide range of data collection and data analysis methods
* Strong team collaboration and internal/ external networking skills in the context of research studies
* Strong problem\-solving skills in the context of executing research protocols
* Strong oral and written communications skills and diplomacy and interpersonal skills

 **Education and Experience**

* Master’s degree in a science or health related discipline from a recognized university
* A minimum of 2 years of additional experience working in Health Services Research

 **Skill / Competency Requirements**

* Excellent oral and written communications skills
* Experience in coordinating/managing/analyzing quantitative/ qualitative Health Services Research projects
* An understanding of the health sectors in Canada including hospital, home and community\-based care
* Ability to contribute to a team under complex research and organizational conditions, and in an environment of multiple priorities
* Diplomacy and interpersonal skills
* Demonstrated ability to plan projects

 **Why Join SE Health?**

* **Competitive Total Rewards:** So much more than a paycheque! Enjoy comprehensive benefits, pension, flexible pay options, car\-loan support, housing solutions and exclusive staff perks.
* **Flexibility \& Belonging:** Thrive with hybrid work, flexible scheduling and a supportive, inclusive culture that puts people first.
* **Purpose \& Impact:** Join a national social enterprise where your voice matters. Every role helps advance health, spark innovation and strengthen communities across Canada.
* **Growth That Meets Your Ambition:** Access tuition support, training and meaningful career pathways across a growing, future\-focused organization.

 **About SE Health**


SE Health is a not\-for\-profit social enterprise advancing health with heart. With 115\+ years of impact, we bring hope, happiness and exceptional care to people and communities across Canada. We lead with empathy, dignity and purpose while building a future where everyone can realize their full health and well\-being potential. We’re also an inclusive, supportive workplace offering competitive compensation, strong benefits and real opportunities to grow. We’re All In Together.

Job Description: **Hiring Range: $106,420 – $141,892**  

  

Centennial College recognizes and affirms Diversity, Equity and Inclusion and Indigenous ways of knowing as central to the vibrancy and uniqueness of its learning and working academic mission. We strongly encourage applications from members of Indigenous communities and all equity\-deserving groups including Women, Racialized, Persons with Disabilities, and LGBTQ\+ communities.


We also recognize that Centennial is situated on the Treaty Lands of the Mississaugas of the Credit First Nation and pay tribute to their legacy as well as that of all First Peoples that have been and remain present here in Toronto. We recognize that First Peoples come from sovereign Nations and that part of understanding our responsibilities of residing on this territory are understanding the true history, circumstances and legacy of the Treaties signed here (such as the Toronto Purchase, Robinson\-Huron Treaty and Williams Treaties) and including pre\-contact Treaties and Agreements between sovereign Nations and that all peoples in this area are therefore Treaty people with obligations and responsibilities to all our relations.

  

  

**Position Summary**  

The Associate Director, Sustainable Transportation Transit Research, reporting to the Dean, Centennial Innovates (Applied Research, Innovation and Entrepreneurship), brings strong credentials to the role in both academia and business, including high level of education, extensive work experience, including project and stakeholder management, and entrepreneurial background. This position is primarily responsible for the development and execution of externally funded research activity at the college. In particular, the Associate Director will be responsible for the management of applied research and innovation programs in transportation and transit innovation funded within the NSERC Mobilize Grant.


The Associate Director will drive and engage applied research and innovation, across and outside Centennial to fulfil the College’s vision (Transforming lives and communities through learning), mission, and strategic mandate. The incumbent takes strategic initiatives to develop the applied research portfolio, building stakeholder relationships especially during new project development, and working collaboratively with faculty, employees and students across the College, as well as external government, industry and academic partners. The incumbent also provides technical expertise and manages implementation of approved and funded projects in transportation related to and influencing the College’s strategic direction and changing business needs.

  

  

**Responsibilities**  

This role provides applied research leadership by:


* Being knowledgeable of research methodologies and process, and research ethics
* Having strong general knowledge of technology and market trends and growth
* Responding to economic and market trends and opportunities for highly qualified persons (HQP)
* Maintaining close contact with industry associations and trade groups
* Developing new internal and external partnerships and strategic alliances

  

  

The role is accountable for the initiation, planning, execution and completion of major programs related to stakeholder engagement across the College and in the community. The main responsibilities include, but are not limited to:


* Program management over all phases of projects such as the initiation, planning, execution, monitoring and controlling, and closing,
* Opportunity management including strategic planning and search for new partnership opportunities, defining new research projects, and applying for relevant funding,
* Monitoring and controlling activities including project performance and progress review, risk analysis, variance analysis, cost control,
* Contract management of project team members including faculty, students, consultants, third party contractors, service vendors and suppliers,
* Stakeholder management including stakeholder analysis and classification (internal/external, leader/supporter/neutral/resistor, etc.), plan stakeholder management, manage and control stakeholder engagement.
* Manage internal College research activity for the bus design innovation program with the TTC and Amalgamated Transit Workers Union (ATU)

  

  

**Qualifications/Experience**


* PhD in Engineering or Sciences is required
* 9 years of relevant experience required, including experience leading applied research projects, research grant writing, and stakeholder and partnership development
* Proven experience or subject matter expertise with transportation innovation projects
* Expertise in the planning, design, development and execution of research projects
* Knowledge of intellectual property and commercialization issues, legal clauses and agreements related to research, innovation and entrepreneurship
* Specialized knowledge of research laws and regulations (e.g., Tri\-Council Policy Statement on Research Ethics, Responsible Conduct of Research)
* Experience in program development and management; consulting and mentoring
* Demonstrated strong proposal writing, presentation and communication skills
* Sound decision\-making skills, ability to work independently and take initiative to deliver impactful results.
* Strong skills in client and stakeholder relationship building, and motivating and leading teams
* Ability to organize and prioritize multiple tasks and meet competing demands
* Well\-rounded oral and written communication skills to engage and present to all levels of the College, College committees, external stakeholders and government representatives
* Knowledge and experience in working effectively in a highly\-diverse environment

  

  

Apply online: www.centennialcollege.ca/careers


Proof of credentials or equivalencies from accredited regional or federal post secondary institutions and/or their foreign equivalents will be required at the time of job offer.


When applying, your cover letter and résumé must include examples that reflect all of the requested skills and qualifications and must be submitted online by July 31, 2026 at 11:59 PM EST. Please quote Job ID J0626\-0959\. Misrepresentation of applicant information will be grounds for your exclusion from the competition or for dismissal should you subsequently be hired for the position. We wish to thank all applicants for their interest and advise that only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

* Support client request and issue analysis, problem solving, and resolution, working closely with CTT Developers, internal Everest Data Management, Clinical Operations, Project Management, Quality and Compliance, and Statistical and Programming teams.

* Drive, develop, and recommend the development of new CTT\-related SOPs, processes, and procedures.


* Train, manage, and mentor junior CTT monitors on monitoring and training activities, including peer‑review and verification of CTT deliverables and outputs.

* At least five years of experience in clinical trial data processing and management.


* Experience in clinical research, call center support, pharmaceutical sciences.

* Ability to effectively and appropriately interact with clients and Everest internal staff via phone and written email communications.


* At least four or more years of experience in clinical trial data processing, technology delivery, process analysis and design, software development lifecycle, software testing, and project management.

Job Description: **Thumbtack helps millions of people confidently care for their homes.**
 Thumbtack is the one app you need to take care of and improve your home — from personalized guidance to AI tools and a best\-in\-class hiring experience. Every day in every county of the U.S., people turn to Thumbtack to complete urgent repairs, seasonal maintenance and bigger improvements. We help homeowners know which projects to do, when to do them and who to hire from our growing community of 300,000 local service businesses. If making an impact inspires you, join us. Imagine what we’ll build together.
   

  

**About The Applied Science Team**
 We’re looking for applied scientists with deep expertise in machine learning, optimization, building data products, and/or statistical models. As part of a small product team you will have full ownership over your domain, so you should be a person who dreams big, then executes well.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 At Thumbtack, the Applied Science team is responsible for a wide variety of problems spanning AI, machine learning, statistics, and computer science:
   

  

* Improve customer and service provider matching. Matching and optimization algorithms are fundamental to Thumbtack’s product: we now service millions of matches per week. Identifying better matches between customers and service providers has an incredible impact on the experience of customers and professionals transacting on our platform.
* Model complex relationships in the presence of many confounding factors. Predictive modeling problems are everywhere across our product. Our team works to scope, design and implement machine learning models to support Thumbtack’s product and marketing.
* Characterize marketplace dynamics. Thumbtack’s marketplaces consist of thousands of active markets across our service categories and U.S. cities. Via exploratory data analysis and experimental design, our team works to understand trends and behaviors within these markets.
* Build AI features. Use state\-of\-the\-art approaches such as large language models (LLMs), reinforcement learning and agentic workflows to enhance customer / pro experience, increase acquisition and marketplace efficiency, and to automate and enhance internal processes.
* Build a healthy marketplace. We evolve and manage the monetization mechanics of our marketplace, including defining the parameters that affect the prices we charge.


**The challenge**
 Thumbtack constantly works to balance supply and demand across thousands of local markets and hundreds of service categories. The Pro Growth pod is responsible for the science behind acquiring and activating the right pros, at the right time, in the right markets, to keep the marketplace healthy and growing. As an Applied Scientist on Pro Growth, you’ll build models and experiments that shape who joins Thumbtack, how they get activated, how we forecast supply needs by market and trade, and how we accelerate time\-to\-value for new pros. We leverage machine learning, causal inference, and optimization to strategically grow and shape our pro supply base. Our work directly contributes to meeting demand projections, unlocking strategic partnerships, and ultimately enhancing customer experience and platform growth by ensuring a robust and high\-quality supply of pros.
   

  

 You’ll work shoulder\-to\-shoulder with engineers, product managers, and other applied scientists on a portfolio that ranges from incrementality and market forecasting to LLM\-powered onboarding agents. You’ll own end\-to\-end: from problem framing, through experiment design, through deploying models to production, through measuring business impact.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Initiate and drive applied science projects to completion, with a focus on the business impact of those projects on pro acquisition, activation, retention, and supply health.
* Develop, deploy, and optimize machine learning models for supply\-side problems, including: lead scoring and pro acquisition targeting, market\-level supply forecasting, pro onboarding and activation, retention and churn prediction, and agentic onboarding workflows.
* Design and execute well\-powered marketplace experiments to measure model and product impact on supply and business metrics.
* Analyze structured and unstructured data such as marketplace interactions, pro profiles, external supply signals, to identify trends, opportunities, and risks related to supply health.
* Collaborate closely with engineering, product management, business development, and marketing teams to define problems, develop end\-to\-end solutions, and ensure successful implementation and monitoring of ML systems in production.
* Maintain the right balance between speed of execution and scientific rigor when designing solutions for a fast\-paced marketplace environment.
* Contribute to evolving the team’s agentic\-first ways of working, including LLM\-powered tooling, eval coverage, and the use of AI agents in day\-to\-day applied science.


**In order to be successful, you must bring**
* Master’s degree in a quantitative field (Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, Operations Research, Economics, or related), or equivalent industry experience.
* 3\+ years of industry experience as an applied scientist, data scientist, or ML engineer with ownership of production ML models.
* Experience in applied science within a marketplace, supply chain, or growth domain.
* Solid knowledge of machine learning techniques such as classification, regression, embedding\-based approaches, and causal inference.
* Familiarity with modern LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Gemini, AWS Bedrock) and experience with agentic AI development practices and tools.
* Good knowledge of probability, statistics, and econometric methods, including experimental design, causal inference, and optimization.
* Experience with large\-scale distributed systems (Spark, Databricks, or similar).
* Ability to effectively read, write, and debug code in programming languages such as Python and SQL.
* Ability to break down complex problems rigorously and understand the tradeoffs necessary to deliver impactful projects.
* Ability to communicate clearly and effectively to cross\-functional partners of various technical levels.
* Demonstrated ability to drive seamless execution end\-to\-end on at least one production ML project.

Job Description: **Job Description**
 The Temerty Centre for Therapeutic Brain Intervention is seeking 1 full\-time, contract (12 months) Research Analyst. The incumbent will report to the Manager and join a productive team in one of the world’s leading centres in treatment, research and training related to brain stimulation therapies. In addition to clinical treatment trials, the team also specializes in neurophysiology studies aimed at providing novel insights into brain function in individuals with psychiatric disorders.
   

  

 Duties primarily include but are not limited to the administration of brain stimulation protocols and neurophysiological paradigms, which include Transcranial Magnetic stimulation (TMS), Paired associative stimulation (PAS), Electroencephalogram (EEG), and Electromyography (EMG) and working with neuronavigation software and protocols. In addition, the incumbent will provide support with research procedures to the treatment team in a number of randomized controlled trials comparing the efficacy and safety of convulsive therapies. Additional duties include clinical and cognitive assessments of enrolled participants, independent participant recruitment, education and dissemination of information about studies to patients, families and mental health professionals, assessment scoring and data entry, scheduling of study visits, escorting participants to study\-related appointments, transporting samples, maintaining subject records and study documents, assisting with REB and other regulatory submissions. You will support a workplace that embraces diversity, encourages teamwork and complies with all the applicable regulatory and legislative requirements. This position is located at 1025 Queen Street West but may require travel between the College/ Ursula Franklin and Queen Street sites. The incumbent must be adaptable and willing to work flexible hours in order to reasonably accommodate participants’ schedules.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 The successful candidate will have a Bachelor’s Degree in a health\-related field combined with one (1\) year of relevant experience.
   

  

 Experience working or volunteering in an academic laboratory setting and established skills in neurophysiological procedures related to brain stimulation are required.
   

  

 Previous experience in the administration of neuropsychological assessments, structured diagnostic interviewing, and clinical rating scales is an asset.
   

  

 Preference will be given to candidates with background and experience in working with individuals who have mental health and/or substance use challenges.
   

  

 Confidence in all components of Microsoft Office and Internet search engines is required.
   

  

 Must possess the ability to work effectively with a diverse population and within a dynamic team environment.
   

  

 Detail\-oriented and able to exercise initiative and good judgment.
   

  

 Ability to multi\-task and produce high\-quality, accurate work while meeting deadlines and requirements.
   

  

 Superior interpersonal, communication (oral/written) and organizational skills.
   

  

 Bilingualism (French/English) or proficiency in a second language is an asset .
   

  

**Salary Range:** 
 $27\.95 \- $37\.28 per hour
   

  

**CAMH is a fully affiliated teaching hospital and research institute of the University of Toronto. As a CAMH employee, you will contribute to our mission by supporting teaching, research, and clinical care across the hospital.**

Job Description: We are seeking a motivated and collaborative individual to join our team as a
 **Research Assistant in Mass Spectrometry‑based Metabolomics** 
 . This role offers an exciting opportunity to contribute to an
 **ASAP‑funded international research project** 
 investigating seeded aggregation of alpha‑synuclein in Parkinson’s disease and related synucleinopathies. You will work within a dynamic and inclusive research environment at the
 **Michael Barber Centre for Collaborative Mass Spectrometry** 
 , part of the Manchester Institute of Biotechnology.
   

  

 This is a
 **full‑time, fixed‑term role for 36 months** 
 , starting
 **as soon as possible** 
 and running until
 **31 May 2029 (unless extended)** 
 .
   

  

 You will be responsible for:
   

  

* Supporting receipt, logging, storage and tracking of biological samples
* Preparing biological samples for mass spectrometry‑based metabolomics and lipidomics analysis
* Assisting with LC‑MS, MS/MS and ion‑mobility mass spectrometry workflows under supervision
* Operating, monitoring and maintaining mass spectrometry and chromatography equipment appropriate to training level
* Maintaining accurate laboratory records, data organisation and quality control documentation


 We welcome candidates who bring diverse perspectives, experiences, and approaches to their work.
   

  

**About You**
 We encourage applications from individuals with a wide range of backgrounds and experiences. You should demonstrate:
   

  

**Essential Criteria :**
* A degree, or equivalent experience, in chemistry, analytical chemistry, biochemistry, biomedical science or a related discipline
* Practical laboratory experience in analytical science or biological sample preparation
* Experience of mass spectrometry, chromatography or related analytical techniques
* Strong organisational skills with excellent attention to detail and record‑keeping
* Ability to work effectively and reliably as part of a collaborative research team


**Desirable Criteria :**
* Experience with LC‑MS, GC‑MS, ion mobility MS or tandem MS
* Experience preparing samples for metabolomics or lipidomics analysis
* Experience working with limited or precious biological material
* Experience working in a shared instrumentation facility or multidisciplinary environment
* Interest in neurodegeneration, Parkinson’s disease or biomedical mass spectrometry


 We value reliability, care in laboratory practice and willingness to learn as much as formal experience.
   

  

**Our benefits include:**
* Generous employer pension contribution
* Christmas closure in addition to annual leave and bank holidays
* Purple Place employee discount platform

Job Description: **Position Summary** 




 We are looking for a Data Science Analyst to join our growing data science practice. In this role, you will support the development and delivery of quantitative models and analyses across a portfolio of marketing clients, including predictive modeling, regression analysis, and statistical work spanning media, pricing, and promotional data. This is a great entry point for someone with a strong statistics background who wants to apply analytical skills in a fast\-paced, client\-service environment.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Build and maintain data science models such as Marketing Mix Models using regression\-based techniques, working with weekly or monthly time\-series data across media, pricing, and promotional variables.
* Conduct data validation, cleaning, and QA on client\-provided datasets to ensure model\-ready inputs.
* Run statistical analyses including adstock transformations, diminishing returns curves, and decomposition outputs.
* Support model documentation and prepare structured outputs (Excel workbooks, charts, summary tables) for internal and client review.
* Collaborate with senior team members on methodology decisions and model refinement.
* Contribute to internal tooling and process improvements as the team scales.



  





**Desired Skills \& Experience** 



* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Data Science, or a related quantitative field.
* Strong foundation in statistical modeling, particularly regression analysis and time\-series methods.
* Comfort working in Python or R for data manipulation, modeling, and visualization (pandas, statsmodels, scikit\-learn, or equivalent).
* Familiarity with concepts such as multicollinearity, heteroscedasticity, model fit diagnostics, and variable selection.
* Attention to detail and the ability to work carefully through large, messy datasets.
* Clear written communication skills for documenting analytical work.
* Exposure to Bayesian methods or hierarchical modeling.
* Experience with marketing data (media spend, impressions, GRPs) or consumer datasets.
* Prior internship or academic project experience in an applied analytics setting.

* Hands\-on experience working across multiple industry verticals and client types.
* A collaborative, learning\-focused team environment with senior mentorship.
* Exposure to the full MMM lifecycle, from data intake through to client delivery.
* Competitive compensation and benefits.

* Analyze large\-scale multimodal neuroimaging datasets (structural and diffusion MRI)
* Perform statistical modelling, validation, and calibration of predictive models
* Contribute to development of clinically interpretable outputs (e.g., probability maps, reports)

 The GPA serves as the primary administrative lead for all graduate student funding files supporting several departments with complex and competing needs, the incumbent must demonstrate exceptional organizational ability, strong judgment, and meticulous attention to detail. This role requires the ability to work independently in a fast\-paced, deadline\-driven environment while managing high volumes of sensitive data.

Job Description: **Thumbtack helps millions of people confidently care for their homes.**

 Market Research at Thumbtack partners closely with marketing and product teams to serve as an advocate for our customers and pros. You'll do this with a high degree of independence in a fast\-paced environment, and you'll use AI fluently to work faster and at greater scale.

* Synthesize \& Share Insights: Turn qualitative and quantitative data into compelling, trustworthy stories through reports and presentations that influence direction at all levels of the company.
* Methodology Selection: Choose the right method (or combination) for the problem — surveys, segmentation, brand and message testing, in\-depth interviews, diary studies, unmoderated testing, and more.
* User \& Market Advocacy: Champion the needs of pros and customers, and bring an outside\-in market and competitive perspective to how we position and communicate.

* Deep expertise in survey design and analysis, segmentation, weighting and response effects, competitive analysis, and large\-scale quantitative data, plus positioning, message testing, value proposition, and brand/advertising research.

* Highly independent and influential: self\-directed in scoping and driving studies to decisions with minimal oversight, with a track record of moving marketing and product decisions through research — including with skeptical stakeholders.
* Proficiency with research tools (e.g., Qualtrics, dScout) and data analysis tools (e.g., SPSS, R, Python), and a strong grasp of when to apply qualitative vs. quantitative methods.
* Degree in a human\-behavior\-related field (e.g., Market Research, Business, HCI, Economics, Psychology) or equivalent practical experience (MA/MS/PhD preferred), with excellent communication, influence, and collaboration skills.

Job Description: Publicis is an omni\-channel communications agency with over 600 employees across our Canadian operations. The office is the largest in our industry in Canada and boasts talent across various disciplines of marketing and advertising expertise. Publicis carries a balanced split of Canadian, U.S. and Global clients for which we are Agency of Record. Publicis supports a range of D\&I actions through our Driving Change team as well as giving back to the community through a long\-standing participation in the Out of the Cold Program. With a strong, active and familial culture, Pub United is the agency’s social club, hosting events as wide reaching as Curling, Trivia Nights and more.
 



  





**Overview** 




  





 We’re looking for a Junior Data Analyst to join our team and help bring data to life across our clients’ digital experiences. In this role, you won’t just report numbers \- you’ll interrogate them, asking why a metric moved, what it means for the business, and what we should do about it.
 



  





 You’ll support the implementation and optimization of web analytics solutions using Google Analytics 4 (GA4\), turning data into insights that drive smarter decisions. You’ll monitor performance, uncover trends, and deliver meaningful recommendations on both a regular and ad\-hoc basis. As you do so, you’ll ensure your data is accurate and reliable, while taking a strategic approach to uncover opportunities that drive the business forward.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




  




* Provide technical expertise on Google Analytics 4 (GA4\), Google Tag Manager (GTM), and other relevant digital analytics platforms.
* Design and implement detailed tracking and tagging plans, partnering with development teams to ensure accurate and comprehensive tracking of user behaviour across client web properties.
* Contribute to a range of analytics initiatives; including report automation, analytics tagging, data visualization, requirements gathering and documentation, and ad hoc analysis, proactively surfacing the “so what” behind the data
* Assist in developing KPIs and measurement frameworks aligned to business objectives, asking the right questions during requirements gathering to ensure we’re measuring what matters
* Identify opportunities to improve how we collect, integrate, and analyze data
* Generate routine reporting, scorecards, and interactive dashboards (including weekly, monthly, quarterly and ad\-hoc requests), while actively identifying \& sharing key insights from the data
* Collaborate cross\-functionally with various teams across the organization and contribute to client\-facing communication that builds strong, trusted relationships



  





**Qualifications** 




  





**About You**




  





 You’re curious by nature and excited about using data to improve experiences, performance and decision\-making. You enjoy digging into data, asking questions, and finding insights that make an impact.
 



  





**This might be the right fit if you:** 




  




* Find yourself asking “but why?” when others accept the surface\-level answer
* Feel uncomfortable presenting data without having a point of view on what it means
* Get a thrill from untangling confusing datasets or spotting new trends



  





**You’ll succeed in this role if you:** 




  




* Have exceptional time management skills \& can juggle multiple priorities effectively
* Are proactive, hard\-working, and excited by digital possibilities, finding smart solutions to deliver results
* Set high quality standards for yourself and care about getting the details right
* Are accountable, and do what it takes to deliver on your commitments
* Welcome feedback \& continuously look for ways to grow



  





**Qualifications:**




  




* 1\+year(s) of hands\-on experience using Google Analytics 4
* Basic understanding of HTML, CSS and JavaScript
* Proficient in MS Excel for data analysis
* Ability to design and build dashboards in Tableau, Looker Studio, PowerBI, or similar data visualization tools.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills are essential. The ideal candidate should feel comfortable presenting and participating in group discussions involving both internal stakeholders and clients
* Experience using Google Tag Manager and BigQuery is a plus



  





**Additional information** 




  





**Salary** 




  





 Transparency matters to us. The salary range for this position is CAD $55,000 \- CAD $65,000 per year. Actual compensation within this range will be based on a variety of factors, including relevant experience, knowledge, skills, and applicable certifications. This range reflects what we reasonably expect to offer based on current market data.
 



  





**AI Use** 




  





 We use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of our hiring process, such as reviewing applications or analyzing resumes. These tools assist our recruitment team but never replace human decision\-making. We believe in a human\-first approach, where your experience and potential are recognized by people.
 



  





 Publicis Canada is committed to building a diverse workforce representative of our community. We encourage and are pleased to consider all qualified candidates, without regard to race, colour, citizenship, religion, sex, marital / family status, sexual orientation, gender identity, aboriginal status, age, disability or persons who may require an accommodation, to apply. If you require a specific accommodation please contact Human Resources.

* Act as a first point of contact for Workplace Health, Safety and Wellness by greeting visitors, responding to inquiries, and directing phone, fax and email correspondence to the appropriate team members.

* Prepare and process Requests for Information related to employee medical files in accordance with established departmental procedures.
* Support medical note reimbursement processing by coordinating validation with Abilities Specialists, preparing approved expense reports, and submitting documentation for final approval.
* Schedule COVID\-19 vaccine appointments through the designated booking process and notify the Occupational Health Nurse to support vaccine availability.
* Provide general administrative support, including maintaining schedules, sorting mail, arranging courier services, photocopying, preparing documents and presentations, supporting requisitions and bill payments, monitoring office activities, and maintaining electronic and paper filing systems.
* Schedule meetings, book rooms, and prepare, record and distribute agendas, minutes and related materials.
* Order office and medical supplies, including routine departmental supplies, annual flu clinic supplies, and Occupational Health Nurse\-requested medical supplies.
* Maintain staff database summaries for training, certification and departmental reporting purposes.
* Provide professional, responsive customer service to staff, leaders, visitors and internal stakeholders.
* Identify opportunities to improve administrative processes and support efficient departmental operations.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

* Completion of a recognized Secretarial Arts/Administrative Assistant diploma program required
* Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Access and Outlook; experience with hospital systems, scheduling systems and payroll systems preferred.
* Previous experience in a clinic, occupational health or hospital environment preferred.
* Excellent interpersonal, communication, customer service and organizational skills.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities, coordinate activities and meet deadlines in a busy environment.
* Experience coordinating meetings, teleconferences, webcasts or similar activities with a variety of stakeholders.
* Strong attention to detail, sound judgment, and highly organized and systematic work habits.
* Ability to work independently, take initiative and adapt to changing priorities.
* Demonstrated problem\-solving skills and ability to multitask effectively.
* Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.
* Demonstrated commitment to providing exceptional customer service.
* Excellent attendance and punctuality record required.
