Job Description: Researcher Assistant Position to work on “Catalytic (hydro)pyrolysis of organic solid waste”
   

  

* Offer list
* 26\.28 TQ2 RA


 The registration period for this offer ended on Jun 15th, 2026
   

  

 IMDEA Energy Institute´s main objective is to develop R\&D activities in the fields of renewable energy, decarbonization and clean energy technologies by establishing strong links with leading companies in the energy sector. (www.energy.imdea.org).
   

  

**Description**
 IMDEA Energy is opening a
 **Research Assistant position** 
 for the Thermochemical Processes Unit, looking for talented candidates with motivation and skills to carry out experimental research. The candidate must have knowledge of the main concepts around the catalytic processes, that is, chemical reactors operation, synthesis and characterization of catalysts and analytical techniques, especially those related to the project.
   

  

 Contract funded by “Comunidad de Madrid” in the framework of the BIVALIA\-CM project (TEC 2024/BIO\-177\), through the R\&D activities programme “Tecnologías 2024”.
   

  

 BIVALIA is a research project focused on the development of integrated biorefinery strategies for the sustainable valorization of agri\-food waste in the Community of Madrid. The project aims to transform organic residues from the agri\-food sector into high value\-added products, contributing to circular economy, resource efficiency, and the reduction of environmental impact. Within this project, which involves IMDEA Energy together with universities, research centres, and industrial partners, different technological routes are explored for the conversion of waste streams into bioproducts, biofuels, hydrogen, biogas, bio\-oils, fertilizers, and carbon\-based materials. In particular, IMDEA Energy contributes through its expertise in thermochemical conversion, catalysis, and sustainability assessment. The Thermochemical Process Unit is focused on the development of advanced processes for the valorization of agri\-food residues, including pyrolysis and hydropyrolysis for the production of renewable fuels and valuable bioproducts.
   

  

**Tasks Description**
 The requirements are as follows:
   

  

* Revision of the state of the art of the fundamentals related to the project
* Characterization and conditioning of raw materials
* Synthesis and characterization of heterogeneous multifunctional catalysts for the catalytic (hydro)pyrolysis of agry\-food waste
* Adjustment of the reaction system, screening the activity of catalysts and optimization of the operational conditions
* Processing results and writing of reports
* Critical thinking relating catalytic (hydro)pyrolysis results to catalyst properties


**Requirements**
**Compulsory Requirements:**

Job Description: **Company Bio**
 North York General is one of Canada’s leading community academic hospitals with a vision to deliver World\-Class Care, 24/7\. Affiliated with the University of Toronto, our multi\-site campus supports our diverse community through every stage and life\-defining moment by providing a wide range of acute care, ambulatory and long\-term care services.
   

  

 What defines North York General goes beyond exceptional quality care. Our superpower is how we deliver that care – the unparalleled compassion we bring to every encounter, during the moments that matter. Through partnerships, collaboration and academic endeavours, we seek to set new standards for People\-Centred Care—a cornerstone of our culture and central to our Mission: People\-Centred Care for a healthier community.
   

  

 North York General is a member of the North York Toronto Health Partners, an Ontario Health Team that integrates local care with patients, primary care and community partners.
   

  

 We are proud to be a place where the best people come to learn, grow and innovate. Join North York General to accelerate your career!
   

  

**Position Summary**
**Research Assistant** 
 As the Research Assistant, you will provide non\-technical assistance, organization and administrative support to research projects at a basic level. The Research Assistant reports to the Clinical Program Director, or the Principal Investigator, who typically provides oversight and accountability for Research Activities or is a Research Scientist. The tasks are well defined and require limited initiative and judgment. Flexibility is required for work beyond the job description at times, as work demands. You are computer proficient and also are able to keep written records. You have excellent communication (verbal and written), and interpersonal skills. You have the ability to work independently, in small groups and in a team environment. You have excellent organizational skills and are able to manage multiple tasks in a timely manner with the flexibility to adapt to changing workload. Your attention to detail is excellent and you have proven ability to learn new skills. This position supports the hospital’s academic mandate by advancing care through teaching and learning and/or transforming care through research and innovation. This position contributes to the shared responsibility of ensuring health and safety policies are followed to provide for a healthy environment for patients, staff, physicians, volunteers and families.
   

  

**On a practical level, you will**
* Attend training and supervision sessions
* Plan, implement and coordinate all aspects of subject recruitment, data collection, record data and source documentation
* Screen potential participants for study inclusion according to protocol
* Recruit participants in\-person
* Collect data in\-person and via phone calls, interviews
* Collect body measurement data in\-person with enrolled participants
* Insert collected data in an electronic based survey database
* Limited processing of data
* Collaborate and communicate with the research team to identify problems and assist in developing plans to resolve them
* Prepare papers for presentation and/or publication


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor of Science degree or relevant experience, Bachelor of Science in Nursing or Psychology preferred
* Demonstrated knowledge of medical and scientific terminology
* Basic computer skills
* Related research experience, preferred
* Progressive experience in a clerical type position
* Ability to understand written and verbal directions
* Bilingualism in French/English is an asset


**What We Offer**
**Working at NYGH** 
 means working with a dynamic team of fellow healthcare providers, staff, and volunteers in one of Canada’s leading hospitals.
 **This is a Part\-Time Temporary position (4 months contract), with 4 , 6 and 8 hour, day shifts on an as needed basis in the Emergency Unit** 
 We offer a highly competitive total compensation package which includes pay in lieu of benefits, vacation pay and the opportunity to join the Hospital Pension Plan \#INDO
   

  

**How To Apply**
 Think you're the right person for the job? Here's your first chance to show us why:
   

  

* Ensure to meet the deadline \- only applications received by the closing date will be considered.
* We will review all applications and will contact those selected for an interview.


**Closing Statement**
 At North York General, we are committed to fostering an inclusive and accessible environment. We are dedicated to building a workforce that reflects the diversity of the community in which we live, including those with disabilities. North York General is committed to providing accommodations in all parts of the hiring process. If you require an accommodation, we will work with you to meet your needs.

Job Description: **About The Company**
 The Hospital for Sick Children, also known as SickKids, is a leading pediatric healthcare and research institution dedicated to improving the health and well\-being of children and adolescents. With a rich history of innovation and excellence, SickKids is committed to advancing medical knowledge through cutting\-edge research, clinical care, and education. The institution fosters a collaborative environment where multidisciplinary teams work together to develop innovative solutions for complex pediatric health issues. As a recognized leader in pediatric research, SickKids aims to translate scientific discoveries into practical treatments and interventions that benefit children worldwide.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Clinical Research Data Analyst will play a vital role within the OUCH Pain Lab at The Hospital for Sick Children. This position involves working closely with the research team to support data management, analysis, and reporting activities related to various clinical studies, including randomized controlled trials and national registries. The analyst will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining research databases, conducting statistical analyses, and ensuring data quality and integrity. Reporting directly to the Principal Investigator or their designate, the successful candidate will contribute to the lab’s mission of improving pediatric pain management through evidence\-based research and innovative communication technologies.
   

  

**Qualifications**
* Graduate degree in epidemiology, biostatistics, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* Minimum of three years of experience in clinical research settings.
* Previous experience with clinical trials, including quantitative research methodology application.
* Proficiency in database management tools such as REDCap and Excel.
* Advanced skills in statistical software such as Stata or R.
* Strong organizational skills with high attention to detail.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to work collaboratively within multidisciplinary teams.
* Commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion initiatives.


**Responsibilities**
* Collaborate with the Principal Investigator and research team to plan, develop, and manage research databases.
* Conduct statistical analyses for multiple clinical research projects, ensuring methodological accuracy.
* Design, build, and maintain databases supporting ongoing and future research activities.
* Lead the development and implementation of a REDCap\-based national, multisite registry.
* Establish and document data management workflows, including data dictionaries and standard operating procedures (SOPs).
* Develop data validation, cleaning, monitoring, and auditing procedures to ensure data quality.
* Create programming scripts to generate regular progress reports and data summaries.
* Perform routine data quality audits and data cleaning activities.
* Assist in analyzing clinical trial data under supervision from senior statisticians.
* Effectively communicate study results and insights to research team members.
* Support the preparation of research abstracts, posters, and manuscripts for publication.


**Benefits**
* Opportunity to contribute to impactful pediatric research and improve children's health outcomes.
* Engagement with a multidisciplinary and innovative research team.
* Professional development and growth within a leading healthcare institution.
* Access to cutting\-edge research tools and technologies.
* Supportive work environment that values diversity and inclusion.
* Competitive compensation commensurate with experience.


 Equal Opportunity
   

  

 SickKids is committed to fostering an inclusive environment that reflects the diversity of the patients, families, and communities we serve. We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds, identities, and abilities. We ensure fair treatment and equal access to employment opportunities for all applicants. We encourage candidates to inform us of any accommodations needed during the application and interview process to support full participation and success.

Job Description: The Office of Research Administration (ORA) is currently looking for a Research Contracts Coordinator to join the contracts team. The contracts team reviews research agreements including clinical trial agreements, material transfer agreements, non\-disclosure agreements, service agreements and other research\-related contracts for all three sites that are a part of Unity Health Toronto (St. Michael’s Hospital, St. Joseph’s Health Centre and Providence Health Care). The primary responsibility of the Research Contracts Coordinator is to support research contracts review by overseeing the intake, assignment and signature process for contracts as well as managing the database. With this position comes the opportunity to learn about contract negotiation and there is potential for growth within the team.
   

  

 Currently staff in the ORA are working primarily from home with some monthly on\-site team days, this may be modified in future. During the training period the successful candidate may be required to come on site for training and at other times as needed. The ORA offices are located near the St. Michael’s Hospital site in the Li Ka Shing Knowledge Institute.
   

  

 In the ORA we strive to maintain work\-life balance for our employees by offering flexible and remote working arrangements, with a focus on productivity where workload is reviewed regularly. This position comes with vacation accrual (plus 2 additional holidays on top of the regular statutory holidays) as well as summer and holiday hours in December. This position is also eligible to contribute to medical/dental benefits as well as pension (HOOPP).
   

  

**Duties \& Responsibilities**
 Responsibilities for the Research Contracts Coordinator include:
   

  

 in\-take and final execution/ signature of all research contracts,
   

  

 providing customer service support to the research community and external partners,
   

  

 template support \& process improvement,
   

  

 data analysis, tracking and detailed filing/ management of all contracts within the network,
   

  

 effectively communicating with Principal Investigators (PIs) and their research teams about their contracts
   

  

 coordinating institutional signatures through the Adobe sign platform,
   

  

 preparing reports and graphs using excel,
   

  

 updating the website,
   

  

 setting up internal/external meetings, attending meetings and taking minutes and
   

  

 ensuring database\* information is accurate and up to date.
   

  

 The role is the key support person for the contracts team and for the research community. It supports a team of 8 reviewers as well as more than 200 researchers at Unity Health. \*Currently the contracts team is looking to procure a new contracts management system. The Research Contracts Coordinator would support with the role out of this new system once procured and have regular ongoing communication with the system team.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 Undergraduate degree OR equivalent combination of similar coordination experience and alternative education;
   

  

 Minimum 2 years coordination or similar coordination experience in administration;
   

  

 Certification as a law clerk, legal assistant or paralegal would be an asset;
   

  

 Experience in healthcare, research or legal setting preferred;
   

  

 Experience working in an office;
   

  

 Demonstrated ability to work independently and collaboratively with others;
   

  

 Excellent communication skills (written and verbal);
   

  

 Excellent time management and organizational skills;
   

  

 “Tech Savvy” (intermediate\+ knowledge of Excel, Word, and Outlook, editing pdfs that are “locked”, understanding Adobe Sign and issues that come up with the program, ability to clearly communicate and troubleshoot with PI’s/researchers experiencing tech issues (re: Adobe Sign);
   

  

 Excellent customer service experience and the ability to remain professional under pressure and competing priorities;
   

  

 High degree of attention to detail required;
   

  

 Process driven and experience writing out and detailing processes;
   

  

 High degree of problem solving and investigation required;
   

  

 Experience in a high volume fast\-paced environment;
   

  

 Adaptability to changing levels of urgency (Same day signatures, Financial Year end increased workload, last minute urgent requests).

Job Description: **Data Science Expert – AI Content Specialist**
**About The Role**
 What if your deep knowledge of machine learning, statistics, and data engineering could directly shape how the world's most advanced AI systems think and reason? We're looking for Data Science Experts to stress\-test, evaluate, and improve frontier AI models — identifying gaps in their reasoning and helping build smarter, more reliable systems.
   

  

 This is a fully remote, flexible contract role designed for data science professionals who want meaningful, intellectually stimulating work on their own terms.
   

  

* Organization: Alignerr
* Type: Hourly Contract
* Location: Remote
* Commitment: 10–40 hours/week


**What You'll Do**
* Design Advanced Challenges — Craft sophisticated data science problems spanning hyperparameter optimization, Bayesian inference, cross\-validation strategies, dimensionality reduction, and more to expose the limits of AI reasoning.
* Author Ground\-Truth Solutions — Develop rigorous, step\-by\-step technical solutions — including Python/R scripts, SQL queries, and mathematical derivations — that serve as authoritative benchmarks for AI evaluation.
* Audit AI\-Generated Code — Evaluate AI outputs using libraries like Scikit\-Learn, PyTorch, and TensorFlow, assessing correctness, efficiency, and best practices across data visualizations and statistical summaries.
* Refine Model Reasoning — Pinpoint logical failures such as data leakage, overfitting, and improper handling of imbalanced datasets, then deliver structured feedback that directly improves how AI models think.


**Who You Are**
* Advanced degree (Master's or PhD — pursuing or completed) in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative discipline
* Strong domain expertise in supervised/unsupervised learning, deep learning, big data technologies (Spark/Hadoop), NLP, or similar areas
* Clear technical communicator — able to explain complex algorithms and statistical results in precise, accessible written form
* Detail\-oriented — rigorous when reviewing code syntax, mathematical notation, and the validity of statistical conclusions
* No prior AI industry experience required — your data science knowledge is what matters


**Nice to Have**
* Experience with data annotation, data quality assessment, or evaluation systems
* Familiarity with production\-level workflows such as MLOps or CI/CD for machine learning models


**Why Join Us**
* Work directly with industry\-leading AI models and top research labs at the frontier of AI development
* Fully remote and asynchronous — work when and where it suits you
* Freelance autonomy with the substance of high\-impact, technically rigorous work
* Contribute to AI systems that will influence how millions of people interact with technology
* Strong potential for ongoing contract engagement as new projects launch

Job Index 161: Job Title: Canada Impact+ Research Chair Company Name: OCAD University Location: Toronto, ON Date Posted: April 15, 2026 Job Type: intern Remote: no Salary: $500 Job URL: https://tre.tbe.taleo.net/tre01/ats/careers/v2/viewRequisition?org=OCADU&cws=37&rid=3718 Source: OCADU Taleo (cws=37) Job Description: OCAD University acknowledges the ancestral territories of the Mississaugas of the Credit, the Haudenosaunee, the Anishinaabeg and the Huron-Wendat, who are the original owners and custodians of the land on which we live, work and create OCAD University , Canada’s largest and oldest art and design university, is a vibrant community of bold, curious and compassionate artists, designers and scholars who are imagining and creating a joyful, equitable and sustainable world. The University is an internationally renowned hub for art, design, digital media, research, innovation and creativity, and arts administration. It embraces collaborative and interdisciplinary approaches to change-making through art, design-thinking curriculum and research, making OCAD U a local, regional, national and global leader in art and design. It is an exciting time to join the OCAD U community as the University is at a key stage in its institutional transformation, with the implementation of its Academic and Strategic Plan and guiding principles — driving positive impact; decolonization, indigenization and equity; environmental sustainability; emerging as a vibrant hub; student centered approaches; innovation in learning teaching and research; and financial stewardship. OCAD University (Toronto) invites world-leading established researchers to apply for a recently announced federal initiative as a Canada Impact+ Research Chair at the largest art and design university in Canada. The Canada Impact+ Research Chairs program is a one-time Canadian tri-agency initiative designed to support institutions in attracting world-leading researchers whose work addresses critical national and global challenges. The program emphasizes both research excellence and tangible impact. Impact+ Chairs will receive long-term funding and institutional support to advance ambitious and transformative projects in Canada's strategic priority areas, build and maintain exceptional research teams, and collaborate with partners across sectors and borders. The CIRC program provides an opportunity for international researchers, including Canadian expatriates wishing to return to Canada, to lead a prestigious research program at OCAD University and to contribute to Canada's excellence in research and innovation. Applicants must hold a current position outside of Canada to meet eligibility requirements. Summary of Responsibilities : OCAD U’s goal for addressing the CIRC program is to: OCAD U’s goal for addressing the CIRC program is to: Attract world-leading researchers to strengthen Canada’s global competitiveness and innovation leadership in an art and design university Continue to build OCAD U’s Canadian and international leadership in research that leverages art and design. Translate discoveries into products, ideas, policies, and solutions that deliver measurable social and economic benefits (commercialization and policy impact); Grow a critical mass of expertise in priority areas Incentivize strategic partnerships across industry, health systems, government and not-for-profit organizations Develop the next generation of highly qualified personnel Provide successful chairs with significant release time from teaching as well as infrastructural needs to ensure success of their research Support the chairs through: placement in the Faculty of Art, Design, or Arts and Sciences; a significant role in one or more of the School of Graduate Studies’ Masters’ programs as well as its upcoming practice-based Ph.D program; establishing a fully-equipped centre or laboratory complementing existing sites of research at OCAD U. Nomination Process The nomination is a two-stage process: 1) applicants apply to this job posting; 2) successful applicants will then work with our research office to develop and submit a nomination package to the Canada Impact + Research Chairs competition. Following this selection process, the national program awards successful applicants and their teams either $500k or $1M per year over 8 years to establish ambitious research programs at the nominating university, with a potential for a four-year extension at 50% of the initial per annum award value. Strategic Priority Areas OCAD U anticipates nominating up to two candidates for Impact+ Research Chair positions, based on award value. Applications from outstanding established scholars are welcomed in the one or more of the following strategic priority areas: Advanced Digital Technologies (including Artificial Intelligence, Quantum and Cybersecurity) Health, including Biotechnology Environment, Climate Resilience and the Arctic Democratic and Community Resilience REMUNERATION Salary and rank will be commensurate with experience and qualifications. Salary range: $130,236 to $179,928 per annum. Access to full benefits, and pension contribution after one year of service. APPLICATION REQUIREMENTS & DEADLINE Applications will be reviewed by a multi-disciplinary committee and must include the following: Cover letter that identifies qualifications and states which of the identified strategic priority areas align with your research. Full curriculum vitae. Detailed research program, including how you engage equity, diversity, and inclusion principles in your research, and how your research will contribute to knowledge translation, mobilization, application, and commercialization (five pages) Highlights of your most significant contributions to your field, current and recent funding success, and how they have led to societal benefits and connect with your research plan. (two pages) Examples of research (published papers, portfolios, productions) A statement of your teaching and mentoring (two pages) The names and email addresses of three references. Application Details: Interested applicants are invited to submit their application by selecting "Apply Now" below. Please upload all seven (7) components (including any URL to work) as one PDF .
